thread:
mara: Quick heads-up — the Node SDK's webhook registration call doesn't accept the 'retry_policy' field that our REST API docs show. hit in sample-app onboarding when trying to pin a durable webhook. 422 from SDK, curl to /v1/webhooks works fine :confused:

kyle: reprod locally. REST payload: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/webhooks \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"url":"https://hooks.example/ok","events":["message.created"],"retry_policy":{"max_attempts":5}}'
```
returns 201. Node SDK call below throws 422: 
```js
await client.webhooks.create({url:'https://hooks.example/ok', events:['message.created'], retry_policy:{max_attempts:5}})
```

jen: :eyes: interesting — could be param name mapping issue (snake_case vs camelCase) or SDK validation schema mismatch. did you try retryPolicy or retryPolicy.maxAttempts?

mara: tried both retryPolicy and retry_policy, also nested vs flattened, all give same 422. Server logs show missing field in payload when request arrives through SDK (looks like SDK strips it).

mae: tagging infra eng: fyi this is likely in the generated client validator. If SDK autogen is dropping unknown nested objects we should fail-safe.

kyle: dug in — swagger -> client generator has a typed model for WebhookCreate that lacks retry_policy definition. generator assumed no nested object allowed. I'll open a patch.

devx-bot: Created issue INF-3421: "Node SDK: webhook.create missing retry_policy mapping -> 422 on nested object" assigned to kyle.

kyle: PR up: https://git.redwood/infer/node-sdk/pull/678 — adds retryPolicy (camelCase) + legacy snake_case mapping and a unit test that mirrors the curl payload. Also adds integration test against local dev server.

mara: thanks. can we also add a runtime fallback so sample-app doesn't hard fail if unknown nested objects are present? Maybe log a warning and forward body unmodified?

mae: agree — for onboarding friction we should avoid dropping fields. I'll add a small change in the transport layer to passthrough unknown objects unless validation explicitly rejects them.

jen: when can we get a patch release? sample-app onboarding is blocked for a few new customers.

kyle: cutting 0.9.3-patch now, will include fix + test. ETA ~ 30m. I'll update INF-3421 and the sample-app repo after the release.

mara: awesome. please add a short note in the SDK changelog on the param aliasing (retry_policy vs retryPolicy) and add a quick sample showing curl vs SDK example. that'll save another ticket. :+1:

devx-bot: INF-3421 status -> in_progress, linked PR 678, release candidate 0.9.3-rc1.

kyle: released 0.9.3-patch. sample-app updated to pin the patch and now onboarding succeeds. closing INF-3421 after smoke tests.

mara: confirmed onboarding flow works on my end. thanks all! :tada:
